acceptanceCriteria: Processor, memory, bus, and device descriptors can be constructed and queried.
Descriptor identities and query ordering are deterministic and registry round trips preserve facts.
Descriptors expose no operations that grant resource access.
notes: Planned acceptance test: TEST-0011 (Ready; not executed in this planning change).
Previously delivered increments are represented by verified child Tasks T-0181. Scheduled in SP-007 to complete the umbrella scope and verify its acceptance criteria.
rationale: Model deterministic Machine resource facts separately from authority-bearing handles and leases.
testSteps: Construct and query representative processor, memory, bus, and device descriptors; inspect that no access operations are exposed.
